subject: biology
title: Power of the Sun
welcome_lead: Discover how plants capture sunlight and turn it into food for almost every living thing.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on photosynthesis, its equation and importance.
final_note: You now understand photosynthesis — the process that feeds the planet.

walkthroughs.body_html: Photosynthesis: carbon dioxide + water → glucose + oxygen. The reaction needs light and chlorophyll.
Leaves are flat to catch light. Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll which absorbs sunlight. Stomata let carbon dioxide in and oxygen out.
Plants are producers. They make food that feeds every food chain on Earth. They also release the oxygen that animals breathe.

mcqs.q: Which direction does water move in the xylem, and what drives it?
options: Water moves both directions in the xylem depending on the time of day.

options: Individual organisms change during their lifetime in response to their environment and pass the changes on to offspring.
Organisms decide what features they need and grow them by force of will.
